entities.name: Planechase
entities.description: The multiplayer Magic product whose plane cards depict forty hot spots of the Multiverse; the column tours them.

entities.name: The Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes of existence through which planeswalkers travel.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara of angel-watched fields, towering castles and leotau-riding knights.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose landscape is founded on the strata of bygone corpses, suited to necromancy.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara that is a world of gargantuans and light-filtered jungle.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane now unified into one in the aftermath of the Conflux, formerly split into shards such as Bant, Grixis and Naya.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara noted as missing from Planechase's plane cards.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara noted as missing from Planechase's plane cards.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: A storm of mana that developed at the chaotic center point where all five shards of Alara overlapped; it was never a plane.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The event after which Alara became one plane.

entities.name: Arkhos
entities.description: A dreamlike plane where night and day intermingle, home to Lethe Lake where memories ebb away.

entities.name: Lethe Lake
entities.description: A lake on Arkhos whose psychic ravages erase memories; some mages seek it out to cleanse the past.

entities.name: The meditation plane
entities.description: An enigmatic surreal pocket plane whose geography mirrors the thoughts and potential futures of its inhabitants; Bolas used it for meetings with advisers.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient, almost godlike dragon who was Emperor of Madara and may still travel to the meditation plane.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: The man who battled Nicol Bolas and took his seat as emperor of Madara.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The realm Nicol Bolas ruled as emperor until he lost to Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: The Pools of Becoming
entities.description: Pools brimming with magical potential that planeswalkers may manipulate to shape effects normally found on other planes.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with an apocalyptic past that is now healing; home to Tolaria, Vesuva, Krosa, Llanowar, Otaria and Shiv.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: A mist-shrouded isle of Dominaria, once home to the Tolarian Academy and now to the new Academy at Tolaria West.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: The renowned mages' school on Tolaria, reduced to ruins after Barrin's Obliterate.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A master wizard whose Obliterate left the Tolarian Academy in ruins.

entities.name: Academy at Tolaria West
entities.description: A new mage school built to heal Dominaria's wounds, with strict rules against dangerous time magic.

entities.name: Vesuva
entities.description: A Dominarian island where shifting illusions produce murderously envious doppelgangers of visitors.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: A forested region on the continent of Otaria, home to ferocious beasts, Nantuko and centaurs.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A pit fighter turned Fist of Krosa who planted the Mirari in Krosa.

entities.name: The Mirari
entities.description: An artifact whose Mirari's Wake caused creatures of Krosa to grow even more huge and violent.

entities.name: Greenseeker
entities.description: A druid who restores Krosa to its former glory.

entities.name: Llanowar Forest
entities.description: A towering redwood forest on Dominaria soaked with life energy, good for druidic training and guarded by Llanowar Elves.

entities.name: Llanowar Elves
entities.description: The elves of Llanowar who may break the bones of trespassers.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A plane overrun with creatures of foul artifice fused with twisted flesh, divided into nine nested spheres.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Named alongside Phyrexia as having impacted Llanowar.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A Dominarian continent, setting of the Odyssey and Onslaught blocks and the storyline of Kamahl and the Mirari, whose land is soaked with memories of magic.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: A city on Otaria, home of the famous Cabal Pit.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A volcanic, dragon-ruled red-mana region of Dominaria, once the site of the Thran's Mana Rig.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased Shiv fully back into Dominaria at the cost of his planeswalker spark.

entities.name: The Thran
entities.description: An ancient civilization that used Shiv as the site of the immense Mana Rig, source of powerstones.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker in his fourth millennium when he discovered Equilor; he later stayed on Moag and fled to Serra's Realm.

entities.name: Equilor
entities.description: An unthinkably ancient plane worn down by time, whose journey through time appears complete.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The remote reaches between planes where Equilor can be encountered and Shandalar wanders.

entities.name: Iquatana
entities.description: A world whose atmosphere is almost pure aether, where creatures warp into other organisms.

entities.name: The Iquati
entities.description: The intelligent inhabitants of Iquatana who created the Narcomoeba.

entities.name: Narcomoeba
entities.description: Creatures floating above the flues of Iquatana, created as living recollections after the Iquati's genealogical memory stores were sundered.

entities.name: Ir
entities.description: An obscure plane containing Turri Island.

entities.name: Turri Island
entities.description: A rocky isle on Ir topped by a stone fortress, home of the Fomori.

entities.name: The Fomori
entities.description: Barbaric giants who live on Turri Island.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane containing the blizzard-wracked Skybreen mountains.

entities.name: Skybreen
entities.description: A blizzard-wracked mountain range on Kaldheim inhabited by a primitive barbarian race.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane home to Minamo and the Sokenzan mountains.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: A school floating over a waterfall in Kamigawa, favored by blue mages.

entities.name: Sokenzan
entities.description: A steep mountain range on Kamigawa that has hosted countless battles among akki, barbarian warlords and frost ogres.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane whose night cycle is Shadowmoor; home to Goldmeadow, the Great Forest and Velis Vel.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: Pastures on Lorwyn around a clachan, a sanctuary for springjacks tended by kithkin jackherds.

entities.name: The Great Forest
entities.description: An endless Lorwyn forest and grove of the Rising, a protected birthplace of treefolk.

entities.name: Doran, the Siege Tower
entities.description: A famous Lorwyn treefolk who originated in the Great Forest.

entities.name: Velis Vel
entities.description: The legendary cavern of the changelings, to which many return once per year.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: A plane whose Mercadia City, built on an inverted mountain, hosts the High Market.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: A city on a huge inverted mountain where the High Market is open day and night.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal world with the Glimmervoid and the Panopticon.

entities.name: Glimmervoid
entities.description: A desert-like expanse of mirror-like metal hexagons on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: A strange mage's tower deep in Mirrodin's hollow center, surrounded by pillars of mycosynth.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Spent centuries monitoring Mirrodin's ecosystem from the Panopticon.

entities.name: Moag
entities.description: A hospitable world with abundant soil, temperate climates and vigorous cultures.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Urza's traveling companion.

entities.name: Muraganda
entities.description: A plane with a steaming primordial jungle suited to enormous reptilian beasts.

entities.name: The Sea of Sand
entities.description: A sun-blasted desert somewhere in Rabiah.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Setting of the Arabian Nights expansion, a mass of planes each a story in itself.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane containing Volrath's Stronghold.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Once harnessed the heat of the magma furnace that fuels his Stronghold on Rath.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A city-plane with the Ghost Quarter, Izzet steam tunnels and secret-filled undercity.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: A district of Ravnica where many spirits have collected.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: The tattered pact whose laws still prevent conflict in Agyrem.

entities.name: The Izzet
entities.description: A Ravnican guild of experimenters and magewright-engineers responsible for the city's infrastructure.

entities.name: Segovia
entities.description: A miniature plane about a hundredth the scale of a regular plane, home to the Hippodrome.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A world created by Serra on white mana as a refuge from pain, tainted with black mana by Phyrexian pursuit and beginning to Planar Collapse.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who created Serra's Realm and was forced to flee it as it collapsed.

entities.name: The Phyrexians
entities.description: Pursued Urza to Serra's Realm, tainting it with black mana.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The creepily charming night-cycle of Lorwyn, where mischief is malicious.

entities.name: Raven's Run
entities.description: A gloomy forest on Shadowmoor once known as Wren's Run.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A mana-rich plane with no fixed location, wandering through the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Eloren Wilds
entities.description: An overgrown flowering land on Shandalar harboring barbed vines that can swallow a humanoid-sized object.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: A plane where Baron Sengir rules the Dark Barony.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire who controls a region of small villages in perpetual night on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: The Dark Barony
entities.description: A region of tightly clustered villages in perpetual night, ruled from Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Valla
entities.description: A plane across which the Immersturm, a continual storm of war, rages.

entities.name: The Immersturm
entities.description: The continual storm of war, chaos and lightning on Valla.

entities.name: Wildfire
entities.description: A flame-drowned plane ruled by the Shah of Naar Isle, with periodic tides of raw fire.

entities.name: The Shah of Naar Isle
entities.description: An efreet-lord who rules a brass-towered city-state afloat on a sea of lava.

entities.name: The Emberwilde
entities.description: An order of djinns and efreet on Wildfire.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A vibrant new world to be previewed soon, containing the continent of Murasa.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent on the plane of Zendikar.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A glimpse of Zendikar on a promo plane card available at the Planechase release events.

events.summary: Four planeswalkers pursue one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons.
events.quote: The four planeswalkers pursued one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons

events.summary: Alara becomes one plane in the aftermath of the Conflux.
events.quote: now that it's one plane in the aftermath of the Conflux

events.summary: The Maelstrom develops from a storm of mana at the center where all five shards of Alara overlapped.
events.quote: it's the storm of mana that developed at the chaotic center point where all five shards of Alara overlapped

events.summary: Nicol Bolas, as Emperor of Madara, used the meditation plane for meetings with his advisers.
events.quote: used the pocket plane as a venue for meetings with his advisers

events.summary: Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas battled Tetsuo Umezawa and lost his seat as emperor of Madara

events.summary: Barrin's Obliterate destroyed the Tolarian Academy on Tolaria, leaving ruins.
events.quote: but it was Academy Ruins in the wake of the Obliterate of Barrin, Master Wizard

events.summary: Scholars build a new mage school, the Academy at Tolaria West, to heal Dominaria's wounds.
events.quote: scholars have built a new mage school, surrounding it with an artificial body of water to create a small island

events.summary: Kamahl planted the Mirari in Krosa, causing creatures to grow huge and violent.
events.quote: caused creatures to grow even more huge and violent

events.summary: Druids such as Greenseeker restore Krosa to its former glory.
events.quote: recovering its vigor and magical potential as Greenseeker and other druids restore it to its former glory

events.summary: Teferi phased Shiv fully back into Dominaria at the cost of his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Recently phased fully back into Dominaria by Teferi at the cost of his planeswalker spark

events.summary: The Thran used Shiv as the site of the immense Mana Rig, source of powerstones.
events.quote: who used it as a site of the immense Mana Rig, source of the powerstones that powered their civilization

events.summary: Urza discovered Equilor in his fourth millennium of life.
events.quote: making even Urza look like a young pup when he discovered it in his fourth millennium of life

events.summary: The Iquati's genealogical memory stores were sundered, and they created the Narcomoeba as living recollections.
events.quote: The narcomoebae were created as living recollections, as the genealogical memory stores of the Iquati were sundered in some unknown past event.

events.summary: Memnarch spent centuries monitoring Mirrodin's ecosystem from the Panopticon.
events.quote: Memnarch spent centuries magically monitoring the ecosystem of the plane from this hidden surveillance tower

events.summary: Urza and Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades on Moag.
events.quote: Urza and his traveling companion Xantcha spent a few peaceful decades there

events.summary: Volrath harnessed the heat and pressure of the magma furnace beneath his Stronghold.
events.quote: as Volrath himself once did, the power would be great indeed

events.summary: Serra created Serra's Realm as a refuge from pain and misery.
events.quote: Created on the foundations and principles of white mana by the planeswalker Serra

events.summary: Urza fled to Serra's Realm to escape the Phyrexians, whose pursuit tainted the realm with black mana.
events.quote: Urza fled here to escape the marauding Phyrexians, but in their pursuit they caused Serra's Realm to become tainted with black mana.

events.summary: Serra is forced to flee her Realm as it begins to Planar Collapse.
events.quote: Serra herself was forced to flee her Realm as it began to Planar Collapse under the corruption.

events.summary: Baron Sengir controls the Dark Barony from Castle Sengir on Ulgrotha.
events.quote: the vampire known as Baron Sengir controls a whole region of tightly clustered small villages
